summary: Implemented the unified verified-administrator settings API for the supported logical namespaces, with strict schema-versioned values, optimistic expectedVersion updates, permission checks, safe projections, audit events, Mongo persistence, runtime routes, and synchronized API artifacts. App/server and inventory wiring outside the task roots were limited to the required transport integration.

verification.notes: Seven focused settings tests passed, covering strict localized settings regression, create/read/update/audit, authorization, stale versions, schema conflicts, secret rejection, unknown namespaces, and route validation.
Workspace syntax, contracts, and API typechecks passed.
Workspace checks and ESLint completed with zero warnings.
The root serialized suite passed its 12 workspace-policy tests and the API suite passed 386 tests.
The 386-test API coverage run passed; aggregate coverage was 85.52% lines, 77.91% branches, and 83.52% functions.
All 13 integration/artifact tests passed, including exact runtime/OpenAPI/Postman route parity.
Synthetic isolated test configuration validated without reading a real .env or contacting MongoDB.
Workspace, contracts, and API production builds succeeded.
Runtime inventory includes getAdminSettings and updateAdminSettings.
OpenAPI paths, schemas, responses, and references validated.
Postman collection and safe local environment validated.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors while backend_123 was in progress.

knownGaps: Production settings seed content and live MongoDB replica-set integration were not exercised; missing namespaces remain explicit 404/unavailable states and deterministic local fixtures cover behavior.
The generic namespace value map is the transport boundary; domain-specific validation and publication projections for individual CMS/settings models remain owned by their existing modules.
The repository declares Node >=24 <25 while this environment ran Node 22.18.0; the checked-in typecheck, lint, test, build, and artifact gates still passed locally.
